sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar
--------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Sanjay Kr. Singh, Advocate
 For the State : Addl.P.P.
 --------
Order No. 04: Dated: 21 February, 2023 st Heard the learned counsels for the parties.
The instant interlocutory application has been filed for condoning the delay of four days in filing of the present criminal revision application.
It has been pointed out that the delay of four days has caused inadvertently and no willful delay on the part of the petitioner.

The petitioner will suffer from an irreparable loss if the delay is not condoned in view the fact that the petitioner is in custody since 10.04.2020 and the petitioner was convicted for the offence punishable u/s 420 of IPC and 66(c) of I.T. Act and he was sentenced to undergo RI for a period of four years and a fine amount of 30,000/- u/s 420 of IPC and in default of payment of fine further sentenced to undergo for 06 months SI and also sentenced to undergo for 02 years RI and a fine amount of Rs. 30,000/- u/s 66(c) of IT Act and in default of payment of fine the petitioner was further sentenced for four months SI.
And therefore it is urged on behalf of the petitioner let the delay of four days be condoned.
Having heard the parties and after being satisfied with the reasons mentioned in the I.A. the four days delay in filing of the criminal revision application is condoned.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 9598 of 2022 is allowed.
Let the scan copy of LCR be called for form the concerned court below.
